fragmentation.proof: At least two disjoint saved person spans; literal offsets equal emitted surfaces; ordered concatenation exactly equals complete rule name after whitespace/cell-separator removal; no intervening content or partial word boundary accepted.
fragmentation.example: ED | GAR TORRES reconstructs EDGAR TORRES only with coherent saved ED and GAR TORRES person spans.
fragmentation.code_verdict_preserved: NO_EVALUABLE if original intact/per-word lookup fails; suggested technical fragmentation diagnosis does not replace code counters.
fragmentation.truncation_priority: Full reconstruction beyond visible tokenizer offsets remains truncation/non-evaluable.
fragmentation.labels: Automatic suggested labels only. Manual technical reviewed=0 and human reviewed=0 until effective review; no claim of100% manual review.

KPI-10.formula: AVG(non-null academic confidence)*100, academic inner join dim_tiempo, effective endpoint gestion; Decimal sum/count preserves numeric rounding.

KPI-18.formula: COUNT pending staging (resuelto FALSE), grouped by year(created_at); absent group returns NULL, not zero.

rounding.rule: ROUND(numeric,2), half up for positive KPI values.

scope.rule: Default chooses latest available CMI gestion; analysis requires exported actual default year rather than assuming2026.

reconciliation_gate: Missing endpoint key, unknown/different scope or numeric mismatch is explicit in metric warnings and top-level endpoint_discrepancies; affected KPI deltas withheld, status requires_kpi_reconciliation; --final exits unsuccessfully until resolved.
